lines.en: \c[1]Embor Palace, throne room of Duke Jaromir\c[0]
lines.zh: \c[1]恩博尔宫，贾洛米公爵的宝座厅\c[0]

lines.en:
Ah... we finally meet.  The Duchy of Embor is restored, thanks to...
By the Avatars...
You are...
Protagonist.  I take it you are Duke Jaromir?
lines.zh: Protagonist。 你就是贾洛米公爵吧？

lines.en: What the...  Guess I look the part, huh?
lines.zh: 什么…… 看来我至少外貌上确实像下凡的圣灵哈？

lines.en: Donar stands before me.  How can I not kneel before you?!  You are here, more than just a myth or a legend...  This is the foremost moment in my life...
lines.zh: 多纳尔站在我的面前。 我怎么可能不向您下跪呢？！ 你在这里，不仅仅是一个神话或传说…… 这是我一生中最重要的时刻……

lines.en: Alright, alright, let's just be people here...
lines.zh: 好了好了，咱们还是以凡人之礼相待……

lines.en: You have come to our world to destroy evil.  There is no other possibility... please, allow me to join the ranks of your army, holy Donar...
lines.zh: 您降临人世是为了摧毁邪恶。 肯定是这样……请容许我加入到您的大军吧，圣多纳尔……

lines.en: I don't have much of an army yet.  But I know there are many people out there just like you, waiting for the opportunity to strike back.
lines.zh: 我的军队还没有多少人。 不过我知道，有很多人就像之前的你一样，在伺机而动。

lines.en: It's quite a risk, the Empire's going to want your hide...
lines.zh: 这么做的风险很大，帝国肯定会想要你的性命……

lines.en: My lands, my resources, and my own blade are at your disposal, holy Donar.  My soldiers are the most resolute in all of Veridia.  Please, give us our divine mission at once!
lines.zh: 圣多纳尔，我的土地、资源和利刃，供您驱使。 全维尔迪亚之中，就属我的将士最为勇敢果决。 请立刻向我降下神圣任务吧！

lines.en: Please don't bow to me.  We're not the Empire, we're the free people of Veridia.  Let's see what the famed warriors of Embor can do on the battlefield!
lines.zh: 请不要向我鞠躬。 我们不是帝国人，我们是维尔迪亚的自由人。 让我们看看恩博尔赫赫有名的战士们能在战场上做出什么功绩吧！
